title: A finitely generated field extension with zero differentials is finite separable
statement: Let $K/k$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] which is finitely generated ($K=k(a_1,\dots,a_n)$ for finitely many $a_i\in K$) and whose module of K\"ahler differentials vanishes, $\Omega_{K/k}=0$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. Then $K/k$ is finite ($\dim_kK<\infty$) and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 090W (lemma-characterize-separable-algebraic-field-extensions, line 44137), implication (2) => (1); the proof of Smoothing Lemma 07FH cites More on Algebra, Lemma 07E1 (Cartier equality) for this step
